rationale: Omitted channel query parameter previously bound to 0 for playlist and segment; now defaults to 1, so requests without channel address a different stream channel.
Replaces slf4j loggers with log4j loggers across bridge endpoints; only log calls change, no request handling differences.

Expired Entra ID token now triggers a throttled silent renewal instead of returning false; failure still returns false. Session credential and group refresh behaviour changes; HTTP visibility is indirect.
Non-https return URL for live accounts previously fell to default connector error (500); now returns 422 with new code P0920 and message.
Validation error messages in form error fields now get a trailing period and capitalised first letter.
Artifact and version creation now passes the authenticated principal as owner to storage, so owner metadata is stored; update path also gets authorization annotation.
addLoanCharges on disbursement period was a no-op; now adds fee charge to chargesDueAtTimeOfDisbursement, changing computed schedule values.
Inline write/admin/curator check replaced by checkCanWrite; its definition is not provided, so equivalence is undecidable.
Adds annotationSourcesInfo property with getter to the aggregate source info model; serialised responses gain a field (null unless populated).
Test stub helper refactored; no production endpoint behaviour changes.
Import previously always returned 201; now empty file gives 400, non-JSON content type 415, import exceptions 500, success 201.
Log message uses throwable.toString instead of getMessage; logging only.
YAML struct tags gain omitempty and new model structs added; models for serialisation, no HTTP operation outcome evident.
Branch delete event now unpublishes a published workflow left with no versions, otherwise updates index; stored publish state visible later.
